name: feature-loop-codex
description: Codex-native feature development loop on top of acceptance-gate with installable role-based custom agents, model-aware budget routing, evidence-backed verification, human gates, and no Claude Code workflow scripts. v1.12 adds Pareto carry-forward (P1 delta-scoped staleness reverify, P2 baseline-once, P3 judge-panel memo) — same trust bar, run-log is the only memo. v1.13 adds the CT-S coverage switch: T2/T3 default-on morphological-scan of the AC space at S1, a required contract Coverage section gating Gate 1, and card-rendered coverage evidence — skipping requires a visible descope entry. v1.14 adds the S1 step-8 clean-context gap-probe (spawned worker, probe-failed non-blocking) rendered on the Gate-1 card. v1.17 adds S4 scope-triage: every confirmed review finding is classified against the contract (in-contract / out-of-contract / unclassified) by one fresh agent, a high in-contract finding drives REJECT so the machine fixes what the contract already bounds, out-of-contract findings never enter the fix list and go to Gate 2 for the human to decide, triage failure fails toward the human (no finding may drive a REJECT), and two or more findings in files no eval covers raise a widen-or-narrow cluster flag. v1.18 adds cross-feature claim index (Claude harness only — Codex parity deferred, see descope ledger); v1.18.1 hardens the claim-scan parser. v1.19 adds the platform-fit gap-probe cross-check and mandatory feature_loop.ui_standards_skill loading at S1; design-pass S1-D wiring stays Claude-only for now (descope ledger d-20260730T050548Z-4723). v1.20 makes every plan or progress summary presented to a human load the human-facing-language reference through the plugin resolver (this package does not ship it, so joining it onto the package root is a dead pointer) and render with PLAN-SUMMARY-TABLE-TEMPLATE — MỌI lần trình, not only the T3 plan-review stop.

interface.shortDescription: Codex-native feature loop with acceptance gates
interface.longDescription: Use Feature Loop Codex to guide a feature from idea through design, acceptance contract, evals, implementation, role-routed custom agents, deduped machine verification, judgment panels, adversarial review, evidence-backed human signoff, and handoff using Codex-native orchestration instead of Claude Code workflow scripts.
